summary: A delightful one double bedroom first floor apartment, offering spacious and well-maintained accommodation.
description:
Enjoying a pleasant outlook over the public ornamental gardens and pond, towards Morecambe Bay. Convenient location for nearby shops and amenities, including the railway station and bus stop. Energy Rating: D Council Tax band: A

TENANCY AGREEMENT: Available under the terms of a Periodic Assured Tenancy.

The successful applicant(s) will be required to pay a refundable holding deposit of £160.38(equivalent to 1 weeks rent) prior to credit and reference checks to secure the property. The holding deposit can either be refunded or offset against the first month's rent. One month's rent and a security deposit of £801.92 will be payable prior to the start of the tenancy. This will be paid into a registered Tenancy Deposit Scheme and will be refunded at the termination of the tenancy, subject to the property being left in a reasonable and tenantable condition.

OUTGOINGS: The tenant will be responsible for all outgoings, including water, electricity, gas, telephone, broadband, council tax etc.

SPECIAL CONDITIONS: Non-Smokers only.

Location Situated over the Hazelmere Bakery, opposite the ornamental gardens.

Outside There is no outside space or parking with this property.
